reviews.t: I love the Sally Hansen gel nail polish and when I ...
reviews.x: I love the Sally Hansen gel nail polish and when I saw this offer from Beauty Brags,  I was thrilled with the price even knowing I might get a color or two I wouldn't use often.  The product arrived in a very timely way and was wrapped securely.  The problem I encountered was that I could see through the wrap that there were only 2 colors I could use.  I suspect the bargain is the result of retired and off color paints.  I decided to return the package for refund.  Unfortunately even though this

reviews.t: It is suppose to be 6 bottles of Miracle Gel ...
reviews.x: It is suppose to be 6 bottles of Miracle Gel polish. I received only 3 bottles of Miracle Gel polish. The remaining 3 bottles were Complete Salon Manicure polish. Definitely not the same thing and there are no returns. I guess you get what you pay for.

This assortment is a great value.  This is probably half the price I would pay in my local drugstore (and I even paid for expedited shipping).  I've been happy with this polish.  I can get almost a week's worth of wear, and I typically struggle to keep my nails chip free 24 hours after painting them.  This requires a separate special top coat, not included in this pack.  But no special light like many gel polishes.  I was happy to get a good variety of colors, I would have bought each of the 6 c

Great customer service. Had issues with two orders I made but both taken care of. I'm in love with this nail polish line. My nails look professionally done. The top coat is thick but it really makes a difference on the finished look. I wish stores had more colors, but I feel like you can find more different colors in these sets than in store. The tips of my nails usually show some signs of wear but I don't really get full on chips. It does crack but I don't mind that after several days. Usually

reviews.t: This is a great deal. Individually these run $12
reviews.x: This is a great deal.  Individually these run $12.00 each, so if you like 3 of them, you got a great deal!  I would have bought 4 of the 6 that I received..  Not a huge fan of the blues...  Although I am currently wearing "swinsical" (right?!) the aqua looking!

I'm thrilled with the colors I received! Absolutely thrilled!!!  I also really like the Sally Hansen Miracle Gel line. In the past, I've not had the best luck with nail polish lasting, but this stuff is great. It doesn't last the full 14 days for me, but it easily lasts a good week. Really though, after a week I'm ready for a color change anyway.

reviews.t: What a disappointment two of the same colors
reviews.x: I was excited to get six different shades of this nail polish as it is my new favorite nail polish to use. I was prepared to get some colors that I would not like perhaps but that was fine. I had expected to get six different colors yet that wasn’t the case instead I got two of the exact same shade. So I only got five shades. Of the shades they were all odd colors I honestly only like one which makes the value not worth it as for the price I would need to like two colors for it to be worth it. P

I originally purchased this because I thought it would be fun to get 6 colors at random, but I should have known better. I strongly dislike all 6 colors I received and the Tan-acious has nail polish around handle area which makes me question if I should even try it out.  Granted, unlike some purchasers I got all miracle gel polishes and none were broken. The packaging was a bit iffy and I’m shocked none were damaged in shipment.  It’s a given that it’ll be a gamble with what colors you get, but

I am really pleased with this purchase. Nice variety of colors. 5/6 are colors I would have picked myself.  I received: Beatnik Rhapsody red S-teal the show Malibu peach Hunger flames Rock on (this is the only one I'm not crazy about)

reviews.t: Amazon rocks, the colors I got did not.
reviews.x: There are colors not pictured that you can also get and I must have received the not so pretty color batch.  Although, pretty is in the eyes of the beholder so just be aware. I'm not a lime green, short circuit orange, perwinkle, 2 nudes and a breast cancer pink nail color wearer. These can not be returned.

reviews.t: I hesitated but I'm glad I took a risk!
reviews.x: I love the colors!!!! I would wear all of them. I was not sure about the 150 Truffle Shuffle color (the mocha looking one) but it looks good. It's a different take on a neutral.

Ordered this product twice... once a 10 pack which received ALL salon manicure bottles and even the colors were so bad.. like 3 shades of pink, white etc almost no difference!!! Once a 6 pack which had 2 shades with noticeable difference rest was all junk nude shades NO ONE could ever see the difference expect the name on the bottle. Don’t waste your time and money... there is NO REFUND policy on this which is NOT mentioned anywhere when u buy even being available on prime!!!!!

This is the best nail polish I've ever owned. I never used to paint my nails because the second I put the polish on it would chip. I get a solid week of wear on this before the first chip and even then it's just little chips for another week or so! The surprise variety of this package was so fun! I loved all but maybe one color! The picture on my nails is after a week!

reviews.t: A friend of mine had recommended the Sally Hansen Miracle Gel Polish to me
reviews.x: A friend of mine had recommended the Sally Hansen Miracle Gel Polish to me, promising me that it was the best nail polish she ever had.  As a nail polish addict with limited funds, I was intrigued by the recommendation, yet saddened by the $10 price tag in stores.  I bought the 6-piece random color collection from Beauty Brags since it was such a deal (60% in-store prices) and I like the idea of being surprised by the colors I would receive. I was not disappointed!  I received a classy creme, li
The nail polish bottles has some sort of dark and glitter polish over each bottle. I also noticed certain bottles were half full. Which has me wondering are the polishes used ?
If I could give it a 0 I would. None of the polishes where the brand they were supposed to be! They were from Rite Aid with 1.99 stickers on them! Buyer Beware

Just as many of you are thinking great price for 6 polishes, even if I get 2 or 3 I would be ahead of the game. Please think twice. Received the package as indicated, wrapped securely. Every single color is nothing I would wear. What puzzles me even more 3 were pinks, different hues, still the same color family. Then I received 2 reds, one reddish orange and the other orange reddish.  Unable to return, indicated "Flammable" not sure that makes any sense because it was shipped to me??? Immediatel

I'm not going to write a review on the product itself because Sally Hansen isn't the seller. So 5 stars to the seller!! Came in super fast and I even was given a top coat because I messaged and asked them about it! Two of the colors I got are ones I wanted and the other 4 are ones I never would have bought, but I took a chance and they are fun colors which is out of my norm so I'm excited to try them out! They were all individually wrapped so no damage and all in all I'm really pleased. As far a

This PRODUCT is AMAZING!!! So I was THRILLED to stumble upon this value pack.  I read that I was going to recieve colors not of my choosing, however I scrolled through the POSITIVE remarks/pics of colors received....my mistake.  I LIKE 2 of the 6 colors...MIGHT wear 1 of them...and WILL NOT wear the brown...neon green....or bizzare yellow collor I received.  So...I guess this purchase is a bit of a gamble.  You might get lucky...you might not.  Take your chances!!!

reviews.t: I do love the product and colors i got but definitely not ...
reviews.x: I was originally writing a 5 star review until my boyfriend discovered one of the bottles was broken and cut himself with the glass residue. The packaging did not have any padding or support or bubble wrap in which we could have avoided this whole thing. I much rather pay full price and guarantee colors I want than cut myself because of negligence on the sellers behalf. I do love the product and colors i got but definitely not worth it. Will not buy again.

reviews.t: Really good value, gel colors last a long time.
reviews.x: A friend of mine gave me one of these polishes in hot pink and I really liked how long the Polish lasts. You do need to add a coat of the Gel Top Coat.  I read some of the negative reviews and took a chance, I figured I could give away any colors I didn't like. But they arrived quickly, nicely wrapped in bubble wrap, and the colors are pretty.  Not all are my favorite, but funny enough they match a lot of clothes I own.

This product is in the correct packing, and is nail polish but I don't believe this is right. The quality of these vs the ones I purchased from the store is not the same. These smell as if they were diluted with polish remover, and the consistency is not the same. This has the consistency of regular nail polish, not the gel polish. This is a typical case of "too good to be true..."

This is a good deal. Even at the grocery store on sale these are $7.99 a bottle. I ordered two of these sets now. I got colors that I probably wouldn't have normally picked out on my own but I actually really like. I did get one repeat color in my second package.
Two of the same colors, none of which I liked. Only three of the 6 were any good. The rest bubbled as soon as it hit my nail. Save your $20.

claims.text: Many reviewers consider the assortment a great value for the price, often noting it costs much less than buying individually or in drugstores.
Several reviewers praise the polish's longevity, reporting about a week of wear before chipping.
Some reviewers were disappointed by the random color selection, receiving duplicate shades or colors they disliked.
Some reviewers report receiving the wrong product or incorrect bottle counts, such as Complete Salon Manicure instead of Miracle Gel.
A few reviewers mention issues with bottle condition, including polish around the handle or bottles appearing half full.

qa.q: How long does the polish actually last without chipping?
qa.answer: Reviewers report the polish lasts about a week before chipping: one gets a solid week before the first chip [1], another gets almost a week's wear [3], and another says it easily lasts a good week though not the full 14 days [4]. Note that some reviewers mention needing a separate gel top coat for this wear [3][6].

claims.text: One reviewer gets a solid week of wear before the first chip.
Another reviewer gets almost a week's worth of wear.
Another says it doesn't last the full 14 days but easily lasts a good week.
Some reviewers note a separate gel top coat is required.

qa.q: Do I need a UV lamp to cure it?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Will the colors I receive be random or can I choose?
qa.answer: The reviews indicate colors are not chosen by the buyer and arrive at random [1][2][4]. Reviewers describe it as a gamble and note they received colors not of their choosing [1][2][3].

claims.text: Colors arrive at random and are not chosen by the buyer.
Reviewers describe the purchase as a gamble with colors not of their choosing.

qa.q: How easy is it to remove?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.
